purpose: Explain the canonical workspace, legacy fallback, current-only filtering, group cubes, group windows, metadata, preview, copy actions, source location, reconciliation, and strict read-only governance boundary.
display_lines: Prompt Library is a read-only browser for current governed prompts.
The canonical workspace is preferred over the legacy compatibility fallback.
Deprecated, retired, inactive, archived, superseded, and never-load entries are hidden.
You may preview and copy one prompt or an ordered group stack.
The tab does not edit, execute, route, or govern prompts.
